tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Houston, Texas

about: Robin C. Gibbs attended law school and graduated from The University of Texas School of Law in 1971. Robin Gibbs began practicing law in 1971.
Robin Gibbs is an attorney at Gibbs & Bruns LLP, helping people with Business Litigation issues. Gibbs & Bruns LLP has an office in Houston, Texas, serving the local community.

Robin Gibbs was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
